description: Read bounded historical review evidence from this checkout's GitHub origin through the existing gh CLI login. No local LLM, new model job, Git write or remote write. Missing GitHub access leaves ordinary code learning available. Returns historical, untrusted review excerpts and portable references for pathrule_record_learning. Does not store raw comments or infer team rules; bot, external and dismissed reviews are excluded. Use for relevant architecture/team-practice questions, not automatically every turn. Follow nextPage/candidates only when more history is needed.

cwd.description: Bound local checkout; origin must point to github.com.

include_seen.description: Default false skips excerpts already cited in saved learning; verification receipts are refreshed either way.

page.description: Bounded discovery page; defaults to the most recently updated closed PRs.

pull_numbers.description: Read up to three specific PRs. Only merged PRs are used.

name: pathrule_review_history
title: Read Review History
